sql: SELECT e.state, (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_state_transitions t WHERE t.experiment_id = e.id) AS transitions, (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_deployments d JOIN experiment_epochs ep ON ep.id = d.epoch_id JOIN experiment_versions v ON v.id = ep.version_id WHERE v.experiment_id = e.id AND d.ended_at IS NULL) AS open_deployments, (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_epochs ep2 JOIN experiment_versions v2 ON v2.id = ep2.version_id WHERE v2.experiment_id = e.id AND ep2.ended_at IS NULL) AS open_epochs, (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_gate_results r JOIN experiment_gates g ON g.id = r.gate_id JOIN experiment_versions v3 ON v3.id = g.version_id WHERE v3.experiment_id = e.id) AS gate_results FROM experiments e WHERE e.key = 'liquidity-incentive-mm'
